name: complex custom request triggers handover
description: Customer describes a complex custom request involving custom-cut boards with edge banding on all sides and special sizes, which should trigger handover

messages.text: I need custom-cut boards with edge banding on all sides, special sizes like 2440x1220 with 2mm PVC edge banding. Can you sort that out?
